children.text:
It's been life altering for me.

I usually am slow to adopt new ways of doing things -- but I have about 5 systems I work on and it's nice to have a consistent view on all my desktops.

And as you say it adds mobility, including a way to finally have persistent sessions via the iOS app.

Also started using terminal-browser and that's been a game changer as well, now I don't really need to use screen sharing on my macs to do the web things.

The only issue is for my mac devices is when I use 1Password SSH agent and there's no way to trigger the authentication from the terminal.

source.text:
for any of you that are involved in the beta testing; how has your experience been?

i’ve been personally enjoying it quite a bit. definitely helped further mobilize my workflow. beyond the obvious comparisons to tmux, having separate terminal instances (opposed to splitting pane states), avoiding ssh + tmux juggling, and ability to self host makes for a generally cleaner setup.

curious how others are finding the stability and if it's replacing your existing terminal/multiplexer stack.
source.title: Ask HN: What do you all think of Rex (Superlogical)?
